credibility.summary: Management consistently meets margin and hiring targets but tends to over-promise on revenue growth, requiring multiple downward revisions within the same fiscal year (FY27).

narrative_vs_numbers: Management reports 21% margins in calls, while the quarterly financial table shows a higher 24% OPM for the same 2026 periods.
Revenue narrative shifted from 1.5-3.5% growth to 1-2% within six months, citing sector softness despite rising absolute revenue in the table.
Hiring narrative remains steady at 20,000 freshers annually, which aligns with the reported 'more than 20,000' outcome for FY26.
